segments.en: Tell me, I can hear you.
What? Yes, I can hear you, I can hear you.
I just tried this app yesterday.
I got two or three calls like this, but no one spoke. One person didn't speak, then for two seconds, it sounded like someone was talking, and then it cut off.
I didn't respond. You are the first person I'm talking to.
Tell me, where are you calling from?
You are the first person I'm talking to.
Okay, where are you calling from?
Are you a genuine person? Can we trust you?
Why are you asking like that? I just downloaded this app and I don't know how it works. I am genuine, what happened?
Because I need someone from Erode, that's why. I thought I could make a friend.
I don't understand. Make a friend? I don't know how to use this app. That's the first doubt I wanted to clear.
It's the same. If you keep calling like this, one by one, they will attend your call and talk. All of them are girls who talk.
You can talk however you want. If you want, you can talk, actually. If you ask, they will talk if they want to.
You can talk about anything, share your feelings, share personal things, be friendly, be jolly.
They will share everything. Later, they will ask, 'I will show you a video, will you call me on WhatsApp?' Don't fall for it.
They will say they will show their body, then they will cut the call and snatch your money. Don't get cheated.
If they are genuine, it's okay. If you want to see them out of your own interest, it's okay.
